body: It freezes here for me, stuck checking with `head_rec == 1, vec.iov_len == 8`

Awesome job, it looks fixed. Flicking the mouse into the title bar doesn't crash or freeze.

Resizing is still quite slow and I did manage to freeze the editor once with it, but then couldn't repro it again.

Edit: Something that should be investigated separately is why the scaling can randomly differ between launches of the editor and why it affects this in the first place. As I wrote in the issue, if the scaling is randomly smaller (so *not* matching my desktop's 200% scaling if I look in godot's settings), the problem doesn't occur.
Amazing. Imma wait for @Leaaep to also test and confirm everything is fixed before I mark this as resolved. In meantime Ill look into the scaling weirdness.
Just to clarify, that scaling weirdness can be/should be handled in a separate PR. Maybe create a follow-up issue after #118212 is closed?

Hey @ominousllama I was finally able to test again, the error from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/121831 is still not reproducable so no regressions on my side.

Thanks for the good work :)
